thread:
dani.pm: Quick sync — proposing an interleaved A/B slice eviction plan for the next regional rollout. Goal: reduce blast radius while keeping dedicated tenants healthy. Thoughts?

sam.k: +1 on reducing blast radius. high-level ask: can we make slices pauseable per-tenant instead of fully evicting?

leila.me: pauseable is good. also want a clear canary metric set: p95 latency, error-rate, and model-quality regression (BLEU/ROUGE or eval set) before widening.

nate.sre: we should add a warmback window so paused slices can be rehydrated without cold-start penalties. + add token/burst budget checks.

dani.pm: rough policy I sketched: interleave traffic in micro-slices (0.5% increments), run 30m canaries, if p95 > 250ms OR errors > 0.5% OR "+quality-drop" flag tripped -> step back and reassign to fallback variant.

eli.prod: fallback variant = quantized v1 on same region + global fallback to hosted instances if regional capacity hits threshold. Keep degraded features (no streaming) during fallback.

sam.k: important: surface per-tenant signals in the Console. product needs tenant-level kill-switch and a one-click pause from CS.

leila.me: agree. Also we should avoid oscillation: require 2 consecutive failing windows (30m each) to trigger tenant eviction. Add a 1-hour cooldown before reattempt.

nate.sre: operational checklist items:
- preflight: smoke test on shadow traffic for 1h
- capacity: reserve 10% buffer for rollbacks
- alerting: p95, errors, drop-in-eval, token-burn spike

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary starting for slice 7 (0.5% -> 1.0%) in eu-west-1  — runbook_id: RB-2026-011

dani.pm: sample feature flag and rollout snippet (ops):
```yaml
feature_flag: rollout_interleaved_ab_v2
steps:
  - slice: 0.5%
    duration: 30m
  - slice: 1.0%
    duration: 30m
  - slice: 2.5%
    duration: 1h
rollback_criteria:
  p95_latency_ms: 250
  error_rate_pct: 0.5
  eval_quality_drop_pct: 2.0
```

sam.k: also include kill-switch semantics: if any tenant-specific signal trips, only that tenant is paused (no global rollback) unless >5 tenants trip within 15m -> global rollback.

leila.me: propose a short A/B config for interleaving: A = full model w/ streaming, B = quantized w/o streaming. Measure infra cost delta and quality delta.

eli.prod: add customer comms template for CS: short note saying we may temporarily pause requests and they'll see degraded features; include expected window and contact link.

nate.sre: one more: add a traffic-reshuffle job to smooth out eviction impact. If a tenant is paused, redistribute its steady-state capacity across warm tenants rather than instant spike.

ops-bot: metrics-bot: p95_latency (eu-west-1) = 198ms, errors = 0.12% (last 5m)

dani.pm: good. next steps: 1) finalize YAML thresholds and embed into flag gating, 2) schedule a dry-run on non-prod tomorrow 09:00 UTC, 3) CS review on comms.

sam.k: I'll add the per-tenant pause API and CS permission check. ETA EOD.

leila.me: I'll assemble the eval set and dashboard widgets (quality + infra cost). ETA tomorrow morning.

nate.sre: I'll own warmback and reshuffle job. will also add chaos test to ensure we don't thrash.

eli.prod: can we add a small script for emergency rollback? quick snippet: 
```bash
# emergency global rollback
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/flags/rollout_interleaved_ab_v2/rollback
```

sam.k: noted. we should gate that behind SSO 2FA and audit.

dani.pm: ok team — we'll reconvene post dry-run. add any extra risks here. If nobody objects, I'll create the RFC and ship the playbook. :shipit:

leila.me: one risk: degraded-experience churn from repeated pauses -> add customer opt-out flag for high-value tenants.

nate.sre: risk: sudden token-burn when reshuffling -> mitigated by token-burn budget and rate-limit burst.

sam.k: final: add a small telemetry job to surface cohort-level QPS changes post-reshuffle for 24h.

dani.pm: thanks — closed loop: create RFC, attach YAML + comms + runbook. leaving notes for the dry-run in #eng-runbooks.
